targets.title: Embodied grounding of memory: Toward the effects of motor execution on memory consolidation.
targets.evidence_quote: Experiment 4 was a direct replication of Experiment 1 from van Dam et al.'s (2013) study.
targets.outcome_quote: It is difficult to pinpoint why across four experiments we consistently failed to find an effect of poststudy action congruency on memory performance, whereas van Dam et al. (2013) reported significant effects in three experiments.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All four attempts failed to support the action congruency finding; the authors explicitly describe a consistent failure.

reasoning: New participant samples test the published action congruency finding in implicit memory extensions and recognition replications.
